title: Known-object test, TOI-6347.01
summary: Known-object test on TOI-6347.01: positive control on the catalogued transit(s), calibrated screen for further dips, catalogue cross-match. Runner: Calibration on each light curve (sign-flip null, injection–recovery): k* 3; at the declared k = 5 the screen recovers ≥90% of 4-h dips only from depth 2% (completeness for 2000 ppm: 0%). The null result excludes only dips deeper than that. Positive control: catalogued transit gap, not recovered, recovered (6 covered epochs). Residual screen: 13 threshold entries outside the known-signal veto across 1 light curve(s), forming 4 distinct event(s), 1 persistent in SAP and PDCSAP at two or more baselines. Repeat candidate: a persistent event matching the catalogued depth at BJD 2460641.1539 (ΔT 2.31 d); 0 period aliases remain. Unverified lead until vetted.
